facts.fact: Mmegi states the Data Protection Act came into force in January 'last year' (2025) after years of a grace period and applies to all organisations processing personal data, including public entities.
Mmegi reports that Kepaletswe Somolekae is the newly appointed Information and Data Protection Commissioner, as at 11 February 2026.
